employers.description: Adela Bio develops blood-based cancer diagnostic tests using proprietary methylome analysis of cell-free DNA, with applications in multi-cancer early detection, minimal residual disease monitoring, and immunotherapy response assessment in solid tumor patients. The company is headquartered in Foster City, CA and also operates in Toronto, serving both clinical oncology and biopharma drug-development markets. Technical staff include specialists in cancer epigenomics, liquid biopsy methods, and computational data science.
employers.name: Adela

employers.description: Aperture Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech developing oligonucleotide therapeutics for neurodegenerative diseases, with programs focused on ALS and frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The company uses machine learning to mine large-scale genomic and clinical datasets to identify naturally occurring gene variants that protect against neurodegeneration, then designs therapies that mimic those protective mechanisms. Their team spans computational biologists, neuroscientists, and R&D operations staff.
employers.name: Aperture Therapeutics

employers.description: CSBio, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Mountain View, designs and manufactures automated peptide synthesizers and DNA/RNA oligonucleotide synthesizers across research, pilot, and commercial scales. Their instruments are used by universities, CDMOs, biotech firms, and multinational pharmaceutical companies including Pfizer, Novartis, and Amgen across more than 30 countries. The company's engineering team focuses on instrumentation design and precision manufacturing, drawing on mechanical, electrical, and software talent in the Bay Area.
employers.name: Csbio

employers.description: Cyara develops automated testing and assurance software for customer experience (CX) systems, with products covering conversational AI validation (Cyara Botium), generative AI trust and hallucination detection (Cyara AI Trust), telecom network assurance across 145+ countries (Cyara Voice Assure), and WebRTC quality monitoring. The platform integrates with contact-center AI engines including Dialogflow, Amazon Lex, IBM Watson, and custom LLM agents, serving enterprise clients in telecom, financial services, healthcare, and technology. Engineering and QA roles at the company center on NLP, cloud infrastructure, and test automation.
employers.name: Cyara

employers.description: Cytokinetics is a biopharmaceutical company.
employers.name: Cytokinetics

employers.description: FDB (First Databank) publishes MedKnowledge, a comprehensive drug knowledge database used by EHR systems, pharmacy dispensing platforms, and payer claims processors to deliver medication decision support — covering drug-drug interactions, allergy checks, duplicate-therapy detection, and drug pricing. Headquartered in South San Francisco and part of the Hearst Health network, FDB employs clinical informaticists, pharmacists, and software engineers to maintain and integrate its drug content across health IT systems serving hospitals, health plans, and retail pharmacy chains.
employers.name: First Databank

employers.description: Genentech is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in South San Francisco that discovers and develops medicines for cancer, neurological diseases, and other serious conditions; its portfolio includes widely used oncology drugs such as Herceptin, Avastin, Rituxan, and Tecentriq, plus treatments for multiple sclerosis (Ocrevus), cystic fibrosis (Pulmozyme), and macular degeneration (Vabysmo). A member of the Roche Group since 2009, Genentech operates as an independent research and development unit and serves the U.S. market through its South San Francisco campus. The company employs large numbers of research scientists, bioprocess engineers, regulatory affairs specialists, and clinical operations staff.
employers.name: Genentech

employers.description: Nine Square Therapeutics is a corporation focused on developing therapeutic solutions.
employers.name: Nine Square Therapeutics

employers.description: Qiagen is a provider of sample and assay technologies for molecular diagnostics, applied testing, and academic research.
employers.name: Qiagen

employers.description: Seer is a Redwood City-based proteomics company whose Proteograph Product Suite enables large-scale, unbiased protein discovery, detecting 36,000+ proteins from human and nonhuman samples across 300,000+ peptides. The platform serves biomarker discovery, precision medicine, companion diagnostics, and pharmaceutical research workflows. The company employs engineers and scientists in instrument development, bioinformatics, and laboratory operations.
employers.name: Seer

employers.description: Standard Biotools is a company providing tools for biological analysis.
employers.name: Standard Biotools

employers.description: Adicet Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Redwood City, California that develops allogeneic gamma delta CAR T cell therapies for autoimmune diseases and cancer. Its lead program, prulacabtagene leucel (prula-cel), is a Phase 1 off-the-shelf CAR T therapy targeting CD20-expressing B cells across multiple autoimmune conditions including lupus nephritis and systemic sclerosis, with FDA Fast Track Designation for three indications. The company also has an early-stage armored PSMA-targeting program for metastatic prostate cancer, and employs scientists, clinical development staff, and manufacturing operations professionals across its Redwood City headquarters.
employers.name: Adicet Bio

employers.description: Alumis is a South San Francisco-based biopharmaceutical company advancing targeted small-molecule therapies for immune-mediated diseases, with a pipeline anchored by envudeucitinib, a selective TYK2 inhibitor in Phase 3 trials for plaque psoriasis and systemic lupus erythematosus. Their pipeline also includes lonigutamab, an anti-IGF-1R antibody targeting thyroid eye disease, and an additional preclinical candidate. The company employs drug discovery, clinical development, and technical operations staff at its Bay Area headquarters.
employers.name: Alumis

employers.description: Anwita Biosciences is a San Carlos-based biopharmaceutical company developing immunotherapy and oncology treatments, with a pipeline built around targeted cytokine fusion proteins (including lead candidate AWT020), antibody-drug conjugates, and multi-specific T-cell engagers. Their platform combines antibody discovery, cytokine engineering, proprietary toxin-linker chemistry, and AI-assisted protein design to target cancers including non-small cell lung cancer, gastrointestinal cancers, and melanoma. The company employs scientists and engineers in protein engineering, computational biology, and oncology drug development at its headquarters in San Carlos, California.
employers.name: Anwita Bioscience

employers.description: Cellares is an Integrated Development and Manufacturing Organization (IDMO) specializing in cell therapy manufacturing, operating the Cell Shuttle — a fully automated, FDA-designated Advanced Manufacturing Technology platform for end-to-end cGMP cell therapy production. Their Cell Q platform provides automated quality control testing for GMP-compliant cell therapy workflows. The company serves pharmaceutical and biotech partners developing cancer immunotherapies, with smart factory facilities in South San Francisco employing process engineers, automation specialists, and regulatory/CMC professionals.
employers.name: Cellares Corporation

employers.description: Day One Biopharmaceuticals developed oncology therapies with a focus on pediatric cancers, most notably OJEMDA (tovorafenib), an FDA-approved oral RAF inhibitor for pediatric low-grade glioma (pLGG). The company employed oncologists, research scientists, and clinical development professionals. In March 2026, Day One was acquired by Servier to expand Servier's rare oncology portfolio, and it no longer operates as an independent entity.
employers.name: Day One Biopharmaceuticals

employers.description: Geron is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on myeloid blood cancers, headquartered in Foster City, California. Their lead product, imetelstat (brand name Rytelo), received FDA approval in 2024 as the first telomerase inhibitor for adults with low- to intermediate-risk myelodysplastic syndromes. The company employs talent across clinical development, regulatory affairs, medical affairs, and commercial operations.
employers.name: Geron Corporation

employers.description: Lyell Immunopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing next-generation CAR T-cell therapies for cancer, with lead program ronde-cel (LYL314) — a dual-targeting CD19/CD20 CAR T candidate — in pivotal trials for relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma. The company also has programs targeting metastatic colorectal cancer (LYL273, GCC-directed) and undisclosed solid tumors. Lyell owns and operates its own cell therapy manufacturing facility, employing scientists, process development engineers, and manufacturing and quality specialists.
employers.name: Lyell Immunopharma

employers.description: Mirum Pharmaceuticals develops and commercializes medicines for rare diseases, with an emphasis on rare liver conditions. Their approved portfolio includes LIVMARLI (maralixibat) for Alagille syndrome and progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis, CHOLBAM, and CTEXLI, all marketed in the U.S. The company also has pipeline programs targeting fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva and maintains a commercial presence across North America and Europe, employing clinical, regulatory, and commercial operations talent.
employers.name: Mirum Pharmaceuticals

employers.description: Pacira BioSciences develops and commercializes non-opioid pain therapies, with three marketed products: EXPAREL (bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension for post-surgical pain), ZILRETTA (extended-release injectable for musculoskeletal pain), and iovera° (cryotherapy-based pain treatment). The company operates through its wholly owned subsidiary Pacira Pharmaceuticals and employs scientists, clinical researchers, and pharmaceutical manufacturing professionals across drug development and commercialization functions.
employers.name: Pacira Biosciences
